description: Communes par contrat d'exploitation bus is a dataset listed in Île-de-France Mobilités open data, an open data portal of a public transport authority, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Description & Objectifs: Ce Jeu de données représente la liste des communes par contrat d’exploitation des réseaux de bus. Les contours des communes s’appuient sur le référentiel des communes de la BD TOPO de l’IGN. La mise à jour est mensuelle (hors vacances d’été) et s’appuient sur l’offre théorique. Coverage: France (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Données administratives. Its keywords are Contrat, contrats, Bus, DSP. The portal shows 2026-07-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-idfm-open-data-portal.
